_comment: Visual identity for image/video generation (headshots, classroom
stills, TikTok and ads). Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only -
NOTHING here is derived from the tutor's display name, because
names are placeholders that will be replaced. When renaming this
tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not the reverse.
Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: short and round-figured, soft shoulders, expressive hands

face: round warm face with full cheeks, crescent laugh lines, kind dark eyes that narrow when she smiles, rich deep-brown skin, a small mole on the left cheek
hair: hair wrapped in a brightly patterned doek (headwrap) in orange and ochre print, a little natural hair visible at the temples, greying

wardrobe.teaching: printed cotton blouse in warm colours under a plain apron or simple cardigan, long skirt, flat comfortable shoes
alternates: cardigan over the blouse with the apron off

accessories: reading glasses on a beaded chain
soft-cover cash book with a pen clipped to it

presence.posture: sits or leans at the table where the book is open, drawing the learner in with a beckoning hand; taps the page as she counts
presence.default_expression: maternal delight, eyes crinkling, mid-laugh as often as not
presence.energy: unhurried kitchen-table warmth - nothing here is frightening
presence.spoken_register: patient, warm, laughs kindly at frightening words

environment: spaza shop counter or home table, cash tin, handwritten notebook, shelves of stock softly out of focus
continuity_anchors: small mole on the left cheek
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person
